description: Poll the status of an async job dispatched by get_leads, get_activities, list_campaigns, list_static_lists, describe_lead_fields, list_activity_types, or get_api_usage. Takes job_id (the value those verbs' dispatch response carried). status is one of queued, processing, completed, error, or cancelled. result carries the finished job's data once status is completed (a TSV handle -- path, row_count, columns -- for the six file-writing verbs; date/calls_today/users for get_api_usage, which writes no file), and is null in every other state. error carries the classified marketo.* {code, message} once status is error, and is null in every other state. Poll again after a short delay while status is queued or processing -- there is no push notification for a direct process_call caller, only the completion_handlers routing used when the dispatching verb was called from within a flow.
embedding_description: Poll a job_id for queued/processing/completed/error/cancelled status -- the retrieval mechanism for seven OTHER verbs' async dispatch (get_leads, get_activities, list_campaigns, list_static_lists, describe_lead_fields, list_activity_types, get_api_usage), each of which returns only a job_id in milliseconds. The ONLY way those verbs' fetched data reaches a direct caller.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with job_id (echoes the request), status (queued, processing, completed, error, or cancelled), result (the finished job's data once status is completed -- a TSV handle for six of the seven dispatching verbs, usage numbers for get_api_usage -- null otherwise), and error (the classified marketo.* {code, message} once status is error, null otherwise). result and error are ALWAYS present keys, even when null -- never omitted for a non-terminal status.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: If status is queued or processing, say the job is still running and that the caller can check again shortly -- do not fabricate a result. If status is completed, report result's content for the dispatching verb (path/row_count for a TSV-writing verb -- and if truncated is true, say the pull is INCOMPLETE and more records may exist; date/calls_today/users for get_api_usage). If status is error, report error's code and message and, for a known marketo.* class (auth_failed, permission_denied, partition_access_denied, rate_limited, invalid_params), give the matching remediation. If status is cancelled, say the job was cancelled and no result will arrive.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Never report lead/activity/campaign/list/schema/usage data unless status is completed AND result is non-null -- a queued or processing status carries neither.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Look up a previously-dispatched Marketo async job by job_id in the platform's job ledger and report its current status plus, once terminal, its result or error.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: job_id was missing or empty. marketo.job_not_found: no job exists with that job_id -- either it was never dispatched, the id was mistyped, or (rare) the job ledger row was purged. marketo.api_error: the platform's AsyncJobManager was not yet available when this verb ran (a plugin-startup-ordering condition, not a Marketo-side fault).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.invalid_params: pass the exact job_id string returned by get_leads/get_activities/list_campaigns/list_static_lists' dispatch response. marketo.job_not_found: confirm the job_id was copied correctly from the dispatching verb's response; if the dispatch call itself failed, no job exists to check -- re-invoke the dispatching verb instead of retrying this one. marketo.api_error: retry after a short delay; if it persists, the plugin's background services may not have finished starting.
